notes.title: Advanced Options & Chapter Selection – Update 1.3
notes.content:
This update focuses on allowing you to change the way you play the game. From being able to fast-forward cutscenes to completely disabling the timing part of the battle system, we hope this customization makes Frameland more enjoyable to play for you.

[h3]Advanced Options[/h3]
- [b]Fast Forward[/b]: Fast forward cutscenes and dialogues.
While in a cutscene or talking to an NPC press Backspace or RB/R1.
- [b]Battle Timing[/b]: Disable the timing mechanic in battles for a more relaxed experience. 
We have heard the feedback, that some players wanted to completely disable the timing component of the battles. Note that this reduces your agency of landing perfect hits and blocks (which are more chance based, when timing is turned off).
- [b]Timing Indicator[/b]: Whether the timing indicator (crosshair) is visible in battle.
Can be turned off for an extra challenge or if you simply don’t like the crosshair being visible during battle.
- [b]Remember Cursor[/b]: Retain cursor position between actions during battles
- [b]Text Speed[/b]: How fast dialogues progress automatically

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995022/8b86138856e02c1ded5bcf4250b78c32963d8417.gif[/img]

[h3]Chapter Selection[/h3]
Once you completed the game, you now have the ability to jump back to a previous point using the Chapter Select menu from the title screen. This will be handy if you missed an achievement on your playthrough (see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3392197350]guide[/url]). Note that when jumping to one of these chapters, the saves that are loaded are not your own, but predefined ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995022/7eda8b0fce8bd86e1dda0766b786d84502560180.png[/img]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
- Made more objects in Ailròs Highroad interactible
- Armor comparisons are now “more” correct. Previously it wouldn't show all relevant stats.
- Add new weapons to salesman on airship (Chapter 7)
- Quality of Life: Savemenu, don’t ask for overwrite confirmation if slot is empty
- Quality of Life: Exit menu, don’t confirm when recently saved
- Improved several music tracks

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
- Fix battle texts sometimes "floating"
- Fix Paneca item not healing radiation
- Fix Stunbreak item not working
- Fix ticket quest when re-triggering sales
- Fix turn preview cursor being cutoff
- Fix some dark areas (e.g. mines) visual inconsistencies
- Fix misc collision issues

If you have any feedback or suggestions on other options you would like to see, or other ways to play the game, we are always happy to hear them.

notes.title: 🏆 Achievements Are Here!
notes.content:
[h3]Steam Achievements are finally here![/h3]
There are a total of [u]32 achievements[/u] you can unlock, and most of them work retro-actively. Meaning, if you you already played the game, simply starting the game will automatically unlock a lot of achievements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995022/b52b8f722da7b62abc23b0f5b29f01a28249bc3c.gif[/img]

[h3]Hidden Achievements[/h3]
Some achievements are hidden, waiting for you to uncover them as you progress! If you're aiming for 100% completion and find yourself stuck on a tricky achievement, don’t worry — we’re working on a helpful thread in the discussion forums to guide you. Stay tuned!

[h3]For people who already played[/h3]
For transparency, there are a few exceptions, primarily battle achievements that will not apply retro-actively. However, for some of them we are giving you a small headstart, so it will be partially complete:
[list]
[*] [b]Timing Master: Offense[/b]
"Time 50 attacks perfectly"
[*] [b]Timing Master: Defense[/b]
Block 50 attacks perfectly"
[*] [b]Thieving Magpie[/b]
"Steal loot from 20 enemies"
[/list]The further along you are in the game the more this will be already completed. For the first two, each chapter gives you 5 timings. Eg. If you are at the end of the game already (chapter 7), this value will start at 35, and you will need to to 15 more timings for each of those achievements. [b]Thieving Magpie[/b] will give you a headstart of 5-12 depending where you are in the game.

Happy gaming, and may the achievements be with you! 🏆

notes.title: Version 1.2: Side Content Update
notes.content:
[h3]Version 1.2 is here![/h3]
This late-game update brings fresh side content, powerful gear, tougher enemies, and hidden secrets. Whether you're exploring new areas or revisiting old ones, there’s plenty to discover!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995022/cf379bc0cd7de247fe7da77f5acd77e5cee89ed5.gif[/img]
[h3]Explore New Territories, Revisit Familiar Grounds[/h3]
The airship's fast travel system has now been unlocked! Give previously-seen locations like Jasper, Trovo & Ailròs a second visit and discover what has changed during the events of the game. Or discover brand-new places where additional challenges wait!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995022/6ba5a866efd2d4b0dec6080a609fcfb3900e2475.png[/img]
[h3]The Facility[/h3]
Located on an island far from civilization, this place seems a bit ... different. But not only that, the Swarms seem to be much stronger as well. If you're looking for a challenge, this is it!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995022/f2c1cb794b2ac89a854652a6ba3cd308a6915840.gif[/img]
[h3]Weapons, Remnants & Loot[/h3]
[list]
[*] Over [b]10 new weapons & armors[/b] including each character's ultimate gear!
[*] [b]2 new remnants[/b] with powerful abilities
[*] [b]Many hidden treasures[/b] containing stat boosts and Sol
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995022/45269578e641597d111f99ff6a0e77e4860d3086.png[/img]
[h3]And more[/h3]
[list]
[*] 6 new enemies in previous locations
[*] New ability for the Borax Remnant: Shieldwall (Lv4)
[*] Fixed an issue where you could get softlocked at a savepoint. Thanks for the report @Litronom!
[*] Fixed several small typos
[*] Minor bugfixes
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
And that's all for now.
Have fun with the update and see you in the next one!

notes.title: Steam Deck FAQ
notes.content:
[h2]Launching the game[/h2]
If your game doesn't start up (and it closes immediately again), you can try to using a different Proton version: [b]6.3-8[/b]
[olist]
[*] Open your game settings from the Steam launcher
[*] Go to compatibility
[*] Check the Checkbox "Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool"
[*] Select [u][b]Proton 6.3-8[/b][/u] from the list
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995022/85a4cc4147ae4e703b8a1c9da2ff3159a285284b.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]My saves from the demo are gone![/h2]
Unfortunately this is due to the folder structure on Proton being different than Windows, but your saves aren't lost. We are working on a solution to automatically copy these files over, but for now you have to do it manually:

First, here is how to get to your files on Steam Deck:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zqYgPf4u2yc

[olist]
[*] Close the game.
[*] Go to:
[i]/home/[yourusername]/.local/share/steam/steamapps/compatdata/3247140/pfx/drive_c/users/steamuser/appdata/Roaming/[/i]
[*] Copy the whole frameland folder
[i](this is the folder holding your demo saves)[/i]
[*] Go to:
[i]/home/[yourusername]/.local/share/steam/steamapps/compatdata/2137750/pfx/drive_c/users/steamuser/appdata/Roaming/[/i]
(the difference here is just the end of the number: 2137750 instead of 3247140)
[*] [b]Careful![/b]
If there already exists a [b]frameland[/b] folder here, it means you already saved settings or have a savegame from the full version. [b]Instead of deleting it, rename it[/b] to frameland2 or something, just in case.
[*] Paste the folder in here
If there already exists a frameland folder, overwrite it (see above point to not lose data)
[*] Restart the game.
Your savefiles and settings should all be restored from the demo.
[/olist]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]If this doesn't work for you, here are a few more options:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Here is a save file that is at the end of the demo: [url=https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/2g6arltwnnsaxb1oyc8u0/frameland_demo_savefile.zip?rlkey=qhx50t0ttl5tf8vyvu7j8te2n&dl=1]Savefile[/url]
(there will hardly be any differences unless you spent hours grinding).
Just copy it to the same location from above (step 4):
[i]/home/[yourusername]/.local/share/steam/steamapps/compatdata/2137750/pfx/drive_c/users/steamuser/appdata/Roaming/frameland[/i]
[*] Make a post in the forums and we will try to help: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2137750/discussions/]Steam Forum[/url]
[*] We can also help you directly via Discord. [url=https://discord.com/invite/BA3rdVTc5V]Join Discord[/url]
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
If you have any other issues regarding Steam Deck, just let us know via the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2137750/discussions/]Forums[/url], 
[url=https://discord.com/invite/BA3rdVTc5V]Discord[/url] or [url=mailto:contact@frameland.net]Email[/url].

notes.title: v1.1d: HP growth bugfix + de version fixes
notes.content:
[h3]We Fixed a critical bug, that would lead to characters
gaining more HP than usual on a level-up![/h3]

If you are below level 10, you are unaffected by this change.

If you are above level 10, [b]some of you characters might have a bit lower HP now.[/b]
If your HP was lowered, we put [b]one Vigor Source item into your inventory[/b] as a small compensation.

Why did you lower my HP?
If left as is, this would have seriously impacted game balance.
The game, especially later on, would then be no challenge at all.

notes.title: Version 1.1 & German Translation Now Available!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

We’re excited to launch version 1.1 of Frameland today!

[h2]German Translation[/h2]

As promised, we're releasing the [b]German translation[/b] today. Since our team is German-speaking, we handled the translation ourselves, so we're confident that both the English and German experiences are equal in quality.

For now, you’ll need to switch the language in [b]Settings[/b] on the [b]Title Screen[/b]. Automatic language detection based on Steam settings is [b]not[/b] supported.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995022/48d360e7d1feab6560e1758ef80919dc44eeb8ea.png[/img]

[h2]Reviews & Feedback[/h2]

If you’re enjoying the game, [b]leaving a review[/b] here on Steam would be awesome! Every single review makes a big difference in our visibility, helping more players discover the game.

We also love reading your honest feedback—what you like and what could be improved—whether in Steam discussions, on Discord, or on our social media, so we can continue refining the game.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
We've fixed a few minor bugs:
- Resolved an issue with the castle minigame that could cause players to be placed out of bounds
- Fixed screen flickering that occasionally occurred after battles
- Corrected an issue where an ability wouldn’t KO an enemy even when their HP reached 0 😭
- Fixed item descriptions to prevent them from breaking out of the screen during battles
- Minor script and wording improvements

Thanks for the amazing feedback so far! Next stop: side content — we've got some exciting stuff that we will announce soon!

Cheers,
Markus, Sebastian & Mario

notes.title: Frameland Demo and Release Date Revealed @ Steam RPG Fest
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that Frameland will be part of the [b]Steam Turn-Based RPG Fest[/b]! 🥳 As the name suggests, this event celebrates turn-based role-playing games — just like Frameland!

To mark the occasion, we’re thrilled to unveil our [u][b]first playable demo[/b][/u]. We can’t wait for you to dive in, experience our timed battle system, and get your first look at the world and narrative we’ve been building.

⬇️ Download it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137750/Frameland_A_Binary_Tale/

But that’s not all! We’re also happy to reveal the full release date — and the wait is almost over! After eight years of hard work, [b]Frameland: A Binary Tale[/b] will release worldwide on [b]October 30th, 2024[/b] for Windows and Mac, available in English and German.

Here’s how you can get involved:
[list]
[*] Download and play the demo
[*] Share your thoughts with us! Either here in the discussions, on our other socials,
our [url=https://discord.com/invite/BA3rdVTc5V]Discord[/url] or via [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2137750/discussions/0/4849904176637186016/?snr=1_2108_9__2107]mail[/url]
[*] Wishlist the game on Steam
[*] Run into any issues? See the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2137750/discussions/0/4849904176637186016/?snr=1_2108_9__2107]FAQ[/url], but we are also happy to help directly.
[*] Spread the world and tell your friends about Frameland
[/list]
We’re absolutely thrilled for you to finally step into the world of Frameland. Thank you for your patience, and we hope the adventure will be as unforgettable for you as it has been for us in creating it.

Cheers,
Markus, Sebastian & Mario

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995022/19a5f34a40486f7229b20cd95b1735026ae7ff44.png[/img]
